title: MTSF Session Ingest
purpose: Orchestrates fast or deep semantic capture when sessions close or import. Builds extraction drafts and hands them to validation and graph materialization.
cli_commands: python tools/conversation_os.py session import --mtsf-mode deep --mtsf-llm agent
when_to_use: Every session close or import that should capture semantic structure
do_not: Skip ingest and write directly to global shape index
Run ingest with mtsf-mode off when evaluating pipeline recall
